issues: market-fixa-gate renders correctly, BUT the FIXA 'Top rated pros' featured row + the '17 pros · FIXA verified providers' list are STILL rendered above/below the compact gate. Review spec: 'Market tab → FIXA segment shows market-fixa-gate instead of the provider list.' Current UI shows the gate AND the provider list concurrently. Non-blocking (gate wording is visible) but it slightly violates the 'instead of' language and lets a 0-FIX user still see provider cards (reachable). Reference: /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/marketplace.tsx:528 (FixaGate placed as a header via ListHeaderComponent, list beneath is not conditionally hidden).

action_items: Optional polish: in /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/marketplace.tsx:522-536, when section==='fixa' AND fixAccess?.allowed===false, early-return the <FixaGate compact testID="market-fixa-gate"/> instead of rendering it as a ListHeaderComponent so the provider list underneath is hidden (matches the review spec wording 'instead of the provider list'). Current behaviour is non-blocking because the gate is visible and tapping gate CTAs still routes to /buy-fix and /earn-fix.
critical_code_review_comments: UnlockDialog (/app/frontend/src/ui/UnlockDialog.tsx) correctly surfaces unlock-fee / unlock-balance / unlock-balance-after via testID on inner Text nodes — but the initial mount of these testIDs via Sheet lags one microtask behind the parent unlock-dialog testID (first-pass query returned 0; adding ~1.5s wait resolved). Not a bug, but QA harnesses should wait on 'unlock-fee' not just 'unlock-dialog'.

ProviderCard (/app/frontend/src/components/marketplace/ProviderCard.tsx:200) uses the same onPress for the lock pill and the outer card body, so both affordances correctly route to /fixa/<id> via marketplace.tsx openItem (line 316). In practice web-force-click on the inner Pressable was flaky — card body click is reliable and primary; pill nav is secondary.
/app/backend admin wallet adjust endpoint (/api/admin/wallet/{user_id}/adjust) works for FIX with amount=-100 (used to zero out a fresh user for gate testing). Response includes final balance.

Agent card on /property/57adaff0 shows agent-contact-unavailable because the listing has owner_id=null — the review spec explicitly allows either agent-contact-revealed OR agent-contact-unavailable, so this is correct, but main-agent should consider seeding at least one unlockable listing WITH an assigned agent to exercise the 'revealed phone/whatsapp' branch in QA.
